newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 4-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 4-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6.

text.p: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, February 4-Thursday, February 6 - Reuter European Court of Justice Diary.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-9/95, C-23/95, C-156/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission regulation 2791/94 of November 16, 1994, on a special import quota for bananas for 1994, following hurricane Debbie. Inappropriate judicial basis. Temporary provision of article 30 of Council regulation 404/93 of February 13, 1993, organising markets in the banana sector. Non-respect of the quota allotment criterion fixed in article 19, paragraph 1 of regulation 404/93. - Judgment joined cases C-71/95, C-155/95, C-271/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission regulation 3304/94 of December 21, 1994, laying down temporary measures for banana imports to Austria, Finland and Sweden during the first quarter of 1995. - Opinion C-345/95 France v/ Parliament: company law. Annulment of the European Parliament determination of September 20, 1995, laying down the work calendar for 1996 (in that it provides for only 11 sessions in Strasbourg). Breach of the decision on the fixing of institution headquarters, adapted in Edinburgh. Substantial breach of form. - Oral procedure C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of the act approving in the name of the EU an agreement concluded between the EU and Costa Rica, Colombia, Nicaragua and Venezuela on bananas. Article 1, paragraph 1, first hyphen, of Council decision 94/800 of December 22, 1994, on the conclusion, in the name of the EU and within the scope of its competence, of multilateral agreements in the Uruguay round. Annex I A of the accord instituting OMC - point 1 of the Marrakesh protocol - Article 4, paragraph 1, on agriculture. - Oral procedure joined cases C-364/95, C-365/95 T. Port: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 234, first line. Pre-eminence of articles I, II and III of GATT in relationship to articles 17 and 19 of Council regulation 404/93 of February 13, 1993, and Commission regulation 478/95 of March 1, 1995. Validity of Commission regulation 478/95 laying down detailed rules for the complementary application of Council regulation 404/93 as it applies to tariff quota arrangements on banana imports into the EU and amending Commission regulation 1442/93 of June 10, 1993. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-392/95 Parliament v/ Council: approximation of legislation. Annulment of Council regulation 2317/95 of September 25, 1995, determining the third party nations whose citizens require visas when crossing the external borders of members states. Obligation to re-consult the European Parliament by virtue of EC treaty article 100 C following a substantial amendment of the Commission proposal.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-212/95 Oficemen v/ Commission: trade policy. Action for annulment of Commission decision of February 1994, not to adopt anti-dumping measures on cement imports from Turkey, Romania and Tunisia and to put an end to the procedure opened following the claimant's complaint. Action for incompetence aiming at an acknowledgement that the Commission illegally abstained from taking a decision allowing a formal termination of the procedure, in accordance with article 7, paragraph 9(a) of Council regulation 2423/88.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-267/94 Oleifiei Italiani v/ Commission: agriculture. Action for incompetence and damages. Commission regulation 1429/92 of May 16, 1992, amending regulation 2568/91 on the characteristics of olive oils and olive-residue oils and on relevant methods of analysis. Customs depot. Analytic method - no transition period for olive oil marketed wholesale.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-337/95 Parfums Christian Dior: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 177, third line. Procedure relative to trademarks, raising a question of EU law in relation to the interpretation of Benelux law. Court submission. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of articles 5 and 7 of Council directive 89/104//EEC. First Council Directive of December 21, 1988, to approximate the laws of member states relating to trademarks. Action by holder of a trademark (perfume) and copyright (for bottles and packaging) aimed at prohibiting a parallel importer from advertising as is customary in the sector. Attack on trademark prestige. Damages to the copyright holder. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-129/96 Inter-Environment Wallonie: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 5 and 189. Power of member states, before the deadline fixed for the transposition of a directive, to take measures (a) openly contrary to it, or (b) substantially contrary to it, while presenting them as true transpositions. Interpretation of article 1(a) of Council directive 91/156/EEC, amending Council directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975, on waste. Notion of waste. Substance targeted in annex I of the directive and integrated into an industrial process.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-68/94 France v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision, of December 11, 1993, rendered in the framework of EU control of company concentrations instituted by Council regulation 4064/89 of December 21, 1989, on the control of concentrations between undertakings. - Opinion C-30/95 SCPA v/ Commission: competition. Partial annulment of Commission decision of December 14, 1993, laying down detailed rules for the application of Council regulation 4064/89 of December 21, 1989, on the control of concentrations between undertakings. - Opinion C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 52, 58 and 59. National law on the exploitation of retirement homes. Services of social services reserved for non profit making associations. Public financing of services.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-64/96, C-65/96 Uecker: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 48, paragraph 2 and of articles 7 and 11 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the Community. Access rights of family members to salaried activity. Spouse, citizen of a third country. Limitation to length of work contracts for foreign language assistants.

FOURTH CHAMBER (1530/1430 GMT) - Oral procedure C-201/96 LTM: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 1010/86 of March 25, 1986, laying down general rules applicable for production refunds for certain products in the sugar sector used in the chemical industry. Interpretation of chapters 21 and 30 of Common Customs and Excise Tariff. Tariffs on the products "ALVITYL 50 dragees"' and "STRONGENOL 20 ampoules".

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-205/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/42/EEC, of May 21, 1992, on the output of new liquid or gas burning water boilers. - Opinion C-39/96 Free Record Shop: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 85 and of Council regulation 17, of February 6, 1962: first regulation for the application of EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Agreement or decision of a company association on a pricing system for books. Conditions of temporary validity of an accord reported to the Commission in 1962 and subsequently only insubstantially amended. - Oral procedure C-244/95 Moskof: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Commission regulation 3477/93 of December 17, 1993, on the agricultural conversion rates to be applied in the tobacco sector. Retroactive fixing of Ecu/drachma conversion rates for raw tobacco. Adoption of a specific taxable event for the conversion rates applicable to tobacco harvests before 1993. Consultation of the tobacco administration board. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-26/96 Rotexchemie: trade policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 1531/88 of May 31, 1988, laying down a definitive antidumping duty on permanganate of potassium imports from China and adopting the definitive collection of the temporary antidumping duty instituted on these imports. Choice of reference countries. - (1600/1500 GMT) Oral procedure C-90/96 Petrie: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 5 and 48 and articles 1 and 3 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the Community. Access to the post of deputy teacher in a university. Titular university professors and certified researchers. Exclusion of foreign language assistants.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-80/95 Harnas & Helm: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, paragraph 2, 13 b(d), points 1 and 5, and 17, paragraph 3(c) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Acquisition and holding of shares not related to the activity of a company. Exemption of said activity in so far as it applies to shares issued by a person residing outside the EU. - Judgment C-247/95 Marktgemeinde Welden: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4, paragraph 1, 2 and 4 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Economic activity within the meaning of the directive or operation accomplished by a body in the public sector. Leasing of a building. - Opinion C-110/95 Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 3(b), 8, 9 and 19 of Council regulation 1768/92, of June 18, 1992, on the creation of supplementary certification for the protection of medicines. Granting of a supplementary certificate for the protection of a medicine in a member state other than the one that granted it marketing approval. - Opinion C-14/96 Denuit: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 59, and of articles 2, 4 and 5 of Council directive 89/522/EEC of October 3, 1989, on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to radio and television broadcasting activities. Field of application. "Non domestic satellite licence" delivered in the United Kingdom under the "Broadcasting Act" of 1900. Consequences of non respect of directive articles 4 and 5 by the competent authorities. - Opinion C-56/96 VT4: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 89/552/EEC of October 3, 1989, on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to radio and television broadcasting activities. Field of application. "Ratione personae" Programme aimed specifically at the public of a member state other than the one in which it is formerly established. - Oral procedure C-144/96 Cirotti: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 46 and 51 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. National law granting a spouse, separated due to circumstances, a share of the retirement pension of her husband. Adaptation of this share by reason of an invalidity pension granted to the same beneficiary in another member state.
JUDICIAL HOLIDAY FOR CARNIVAL WEEK, FEBRUARY 7-14.
